places.description: Seattle–Tacoma International Airport is the primary air hub of the Pacific Northwest, serving the Seattle metropolitan area from its location in SeaTac, Washington.
places.name: Seattle–Tacoma International Airport

places.description: Sonesta Select Seattle Renton Suites is an all-suite hotel in Renton, Washington, offering lodging near Lake Washington and Sea-Tac Airport.
places.name: Sonesta Select Seattle Renton Suites

places.description: Ocha Thai Kitchen and Bar is a Thai restaurant in downtown Renton, Washington, known for its curries, noodle dishes, and craft cocktails.
places.name: Ocha Thai Kitchen and Bar

places.description: The Space Needle is a 605-foot observation tower built for the 1962 World's Fair and the defining icon of the Seattle skyline.
places.name: Space Needle

places.description: The Museum of Pop Culture is a Frank Gehry-designed museum at Seattle Center dedicated to music, science fiction, and popular culture.
places.name: Museum of Pop Culture

places.description: The International Fountain is a landmark water feature at Seattle Center, built for the 1962 World's Fair and known for its choreographed water-and-music shows.
places.name: International Fountain

places.description: This address served as a private home-base stay in the Woodinville area east of Seattle.
places.name: 19844 NE 124th Pl

places.description: Lake Union Park is a waterfront park at the south end of Lake Union in Seattle, adjoining the Museum of History and Industry.
places.name: Lake Union Park

places.description: 203° Fahrenheit Coffee Co. is an independent coffee roaster and cafe at the Village at Totem Lake in Kirkland, Washington, known for its pour-overs and pastries.
places.name: 203° Fahrenheit Coffee Co.

places.description: Waterfront Park is a public park on Seattle's central waterfront along Elliott Bay, offering piers, viewpoints, and access to the rebuilt downtown shoreline.
places.name: Waterfront Park

places.description: Pike Place Chowder is a celebrated seafood counter in Seattle's Pike Place Market, famous for its award-winning New England clam chowder.
places.name: Pike Place Chowder

places.description: Pike Place Market is Seattle's historic public market overlooking Elliott Bay, famous for its fish-throwing vendors, farm stalls, and the original Starbucks.
places.name: Pike Place Market

places.description: This address served as a private home-base stay in Port Moody, British Columbia, during the Vancouver portion of the trip.
places.name: 32 Shoreline Cir

places.description: Canada Place is a waterfront landmark in downtown Vancouver, distinguished by its white sail-shaped roofs and serving as the city's cruise ship terminal.
places.name: Canada Place

places.description: The Vancouver Convention Centre is a waterfront convention complex in downtown Vancouver, noted for its living green roof and views of Burrard Inlet.
places.name: Vancouver Convention Centre

places.name: Seawall Water Walk

places.name: Tap & Barrel Bridges

places.name: Granville Island Public Market

places.description: This address served as a private home-base stay in Richmond, British Columbia, during the Vancouver portion of the trip.
places.name: 3971 Lockhart Rd

places.description: The University of British Columbia is a public research university on a peninsula campus in Vancouver, known for its gardens, beaches, and Museum of Anthropology.
places.name: The University of British Columbia

places.description: Whole Foods Market is a natural and organic grocery chain, with this location in Vancouver's Kitsilano area serving as a provisioning stop.
places.name: Whole Foods Market

places.description: This address served as a private home-base stay in Seattle's Magnolia neighborhood.
places.name: 4005 33rd Ave W

places.description: Arashi Ramen is a Japanese noodle shop in Seattle's Ballard neighborhood known for its rich tonkotsu pork-broth ramen.
places.name: Arashi Ramen

places.description: The University of Washington is Seattle's flagship public university, famed for its Gothic quad, cherry blossoms, and Suzzallo Library.
places.name: University of Washington

places.description: Pagliacci Pizza is a Seattle pizzeria chain founded in 1979, serving hand-tossed New York-style pies across the city.
places.name: Pagliacci Pizza

places.description: Piatti is an Italian restaurant at Seattle's University Village, known for house-made pastas, wood-fired dishes, and patio dining.
places.name: Piatti

places.description: Núodle is a Chinese restaurant in Seattle's University District specializing in Lanzhou-style hand-pulled beef noodle soup.
places.name: Núodle

places.description: Tenth West is a breakfast and lunch cafe in Seattle's Queen Anne neighborhood, known for its omelets and paninis.
places.name: Tenth West

places.description: This Bank of America branch in Seattle's University District served as a practical banking stop during the trip.
places.name: Bank of America Financial Center

places.description: Gas Works Park is a Seattle park on Lake Union built around a preserved gasification plant, offering skyline views and kite-flying hills.
places.name: Gas Works Park

places.description: Just Poké is a Seattle-based fast-casual chain serving customizable Hawaiian-style poke bowls, with this branch near Northgate Station.
places.name: Just Poké Northgate

places.description: Target is a national retail chain, and this Northgate Seattle store served as a convenient stop for everyday supplies.
places.name: Target

places.description: The Home Depot is a large home-improvement retail chain, with this north Seattle store serving as a practical errand stop.
places.name: The Home Depot

places.description: Mee Sum Pastry is a Chinese bakery-cafe on University Way in Seattle, known for its giant barbecue-pork hom bow buns.
places.name: Mee Sum

places.description: The Blue Heron is a neighborhood sandwich and coffee shop in Seattle's Magnolia district, serving cheesesteaks and breakfast sandwiches since 2005.
places.name: The Blue Heron

places.name: Ballard (Hiram M. Chittenden) Locks

places.name: Discovery Park

places.description: Kerry Park is a small Queen Anne hillside viewpoint offering Seattle's classic postcard panorama of the skyline, Space Needle, and Mount Rainier.
places.name: Kerry Park

places.description: Alki Beach Park is a sandy West Seattle shoreline along Puget Sound, popular for its beach promenade and views of the downtown skyline.
places.name: Alki Beach Park

places.description: Salty's on Alki Beach is a waterfront seafood restaurant in West Seattle, known for its views of Elliott Bay and the Seattle skyline.
places.name: Salty's on Alki Beach
